description: Figure 6, titled “Token Resolution Breakdown for FedHLM: Local, P2P, and LLM Token Distribution,” is a pie chart that visually represents the distribution of token resolution across three categories within the FedHLM framework. The chart is divided into three distinct slices: the largest slice, colored dark gray, corresponds to “Local (Client-side)” resolution, accounting for 94.49% of tokens; a small, light gray slice represents “Edge P2P Exchange,” making up 1.57% of tokens; and the smallest slice, also light gray, indicates “LLM (Cloud)” resolution, which constitutes 3.93% of tokens. The chart includes a legend that matches each resolution stage with its respective color. The proportions are clearly labeled within each slice, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest segment at the top left, followed by the smaller segments in clockwise order. There are no exploded or emphasized slices, and the chart is presented without any additional visual embellishments.
